patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with generous vertical spacing and large, impactful typographic elements that often span the full width.
Oversized, heavy sans-serif typography is used as a primary visual element, particularly in the hero and key section titles, creating a strong, almost architectural presence.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon, lime green used as a dominant background accent, creating energetic visual breaks.

The initial hero section features a massive 'INSTRUMENT' text element that remains largely fixed or scrolls very slowly, while the background and other content scroll over it, creating a layered parallax effect.
The top navigation bar transforms from a transparent, initially larger state to a compact, dark, sticky header with a solid background after the user scrolls down the page.
Prominent and extensive client logo showcases are integrated throughout the page, appearing in multiple sections to build authority and trust.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a fixed or slow-scrolling background layer for the large text, while foreground content scrolls at a normal pace, achieving a parallax depth effect. This could be implemented with CSS `position: fixed` or a JavaScript scroll library.

Sections and content blocks are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, likely using an Intersection Observer API combined with CSS transitions or a JavaScript animation library like GSAP.

The navigation bar uses a sticky position, dynamically changing its styling (background color, padding, text color) via JavaScript or CSS classes triggered by a scroll event listener, transitioning from transparent to a solid dark background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~8-10x body) for hero and section titles, creating a bold visual anchor, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp corners dominate the overall aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within elements, contributing to a clean and open layout).

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, fixed or slow-scrolling typography in the hero section, combined with a vibrant lime green accent, creates a bold and memorable visual identity that breaks from typical hero layouts. This typographic-first approach makes the brand name itself a central design element.
